title: Voice Agents with FastRTC: WebRTC Made Simple in Python
summary: Karim Lalani explains voice agents and builds one with FastRTC, from echo server to LLM agent.

chapters.title: Adding Speech to Text and Text to Speech

learn: FastRTC is a lightweight library that removes the boilerplate of setting up a WebRTC server; the same app also gets WebSocket endpoints.
A voice agent chains voice activity detection, speech to text, an LLM or agent, and text to speech.
Build-up: an echo server, then speech to text and text to speech, then an agent between the two models.
The app can launch as a Gradio app with a public link, or sit behind a FastAPI backend with a custom HTML and JavaScript client.
Streaming speech chunks as they are ready lets the agent start talking before the full response is done.
